items.title_zh: 福特增加 V-8 发动机供应，并下调 2027 款 F-150 性能版价格
items.summary_zh: 福特表示，这些调整旨在为客户提供更多选择并帮助扩大关键车型销量，这是首席执行官吉姆·法利一直推崇的策略。

items.title: This AI play has an unshakeable moat, but has flown under the radar
items.summary: Investors who want to benefit from the AI boom maybe overlooking this stock, which is poised to double its revenue in the next three to four years.

items.summary_zh: 希望从 AI 热潮中获益的投资者或许忽略了这只股票，其收入有望在未来三到四年内翻倍。
